### The Move to Nazareth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/move-nazareth
Passage: Matthew 2:19-23
Points:
- God demonstrated His sovereign providence by protecting Jesus through divine warnings in dreams.
- Joseph acted with practical wisdom by avoiding Judea under Archelaus and settling in Galilee.
- The reference to "prophets" points to broad Old Testament themes rather than a single proof text.
- Jesus living in lowly Nazareth fulfilled the prophetic motif of a despised and humble Messiah.
- Understanding Christ's messianic mission requires examining overarching biblical patterns and narratives.
